name: InspireHEP_search_papers
description: Search high-energy physics literature in INSPIRE-HEP. Results use exact one-based page pagination: begin with page=1 and continue with metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true; metadata.total_results is exact. Returns titles, authors, abstracts, citation counts, DOI and arXiv identifiers.

q.description: INSPIRE search query. Examples: 'higgs boson discovery', 'author:einstein', 'a:witten AND string theory', 'dark matter direct detection', 'cn:atlas AND higgs', 't:gravitational waves'. Use field prefixes: a: or author:, t: or title:, j: journal, cn: collaboration

sort.description: Sort order. Values: 'mostrecent' (default), 'mostcited'. Examples: 'mostcited' to get highest-cited papers first

page.description: One-based result page. Continue with metadata.next_page.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. Default includes titles, authors, abstract, citations. Example: 'titles,authors,abstract,citation_count,arxiv_eprints,dois'

source.description: Which source supplied this title, e.g. 'arXiv'. A record carries several titles and this is what distinguishes the published one from the preprint's.

subtitle.description: Subtitle of the work, e.g. 'Future Circular Collider Conceptual Design Report'. Measured on 2 of 8 titles - for a report series the subtitle carries the actual identity.

categories.description: arXiv categories for the eprint, e.g. ['hep-ph', ...]. Which subfield the work was posted to.

source.description: Which source supplied the DOI, e.g. 'bibmatch'. Measured on 2 of 5 records. A DOI matched automatically rather than deposited can be wrong.

$schema.description: The INSPIRE schema the record follows, e.g. 'https://inspirehep.net/schemas/records/hep.json'. Which record type it is, and so which fields may be present.

_oai.description: OAI-PMH harvesting metadata - sets, id and updated. Which OAI sets the record belongs to, for anyone mirroring INSPIRE.

abstracts.description: The record's abstracts, each with its 'source' and 'value' - 2 on the measured record, from the publisher and from arXiv. They differ, and which one is quoted matters.

accelerator_experiments.description: Experiments or collaborations the work belongs to, each with a legacy_name and record link, e.g. 'NNPDF'. Measured on 4 of 5 records - which collaboration produced the result.

author_count.description: How many authors the work has, e.g. 11. A 3000-author collaboration paper and a 2-author one are different objects, and the truncated author list does not reveal which.

book_series.description: The series the work belongs to, e.g. 'CERN Yellow Reports'. Measured on 1 of 5 - and for a report the series is how it is actually cited.

citeable.description: True when INSPIRE counts the record in citation statistics. A non-citeable record's citations are not tracked, so a count of 0 may mean 'not counted' rather than 'uncited'.

control_number.description: INSPIRE's own record id, e.g. 1325552. The stable key; the DOI may be absent on a preprint.

core.description: True when the record is in INSPIRE's CORE set - the curated subset of genuine HEP literature. False means it was harvested but not vetted.

curated.description: True when a human has checked the record. An uncurated record's author affiliations and references are machine-extracted.

deleted_records.description: Records this one superseded, each as a $ref. Measured on 1 of 5 - a merged duplicate, which is why two INSPIRE ids can resolve to one work.

document_type.description: What kind of document it is, e.g. ['article'], 'thesis', 'conference paper', 'book'. A conference proceeding and a journal article carry very different weight in HEP.

documents.description: Attached full-text documents, each with a filename and description. Measured on 4 of 5 records - the fulltext INSPIRE actually holds, as distinct from a publisher link.

earliest_date.description: The earliest date of any version, e.g. '2014-10-31'. What a chronological sort should use; the publication date can be months later.

energy_ranges.description: Collision energy ranges the work concerns, e.g. ['1-10 TeV']. Measured on 1 of 5 records. In HEP the energy range is a primary filter, and nothing else in the record carries it.

external_system_identifiers.description: Ids in other systems, each with its schema and value, e.g. {'schema': 'ADS', 'value': '2015...'} - 2 on the measured record. The join to ADS, Semantic Scholar and the publisher.

facet_author_name.description: Author names in INSPIRE's disambiguated 'bai_name' form, e.g. ['1000999_Jose Ignacio Latorre', ...]. The id prefix is what distinguishes two physicists with the same name.

figures.description: Extracted figures, each with a filename and caption. Measured on 3 of 5 records.

first_author.description: The first author, with their full name, affiliations and identifiers. Who the work is cited as in HEP convention, which for a large collaboration is not meaningful.

imprints.description: Publisher imprint details, each with its date, e.g. {'date': '2015-04-08'}. Measured on 3 of 5 records.

inspire_categories.description: INSPIRE's own subject terms, each with a 'term', e.g. 'Phenomenology-HEP'. Curated rather than author-assigned, so they are consistent across the corpus where arXiv categories are not.

isbns.description: ISBNs where the work is a book or report, e.g. [{'value': '9789290833895'}]. Measured on 1 of 5.

journal_title_variants.description: Abbreviations the journal is known by, e.g. ['JHEP']. Measured on 4 of 5 records, and what lets a reference string be matched.

keywords.description: Keywords for the work, each with its 'source' and 'value' - 21 on the measured record. The source matters: author keywords and INSPIRE's curated ones are different vocabularies.

legacy_creation_date.description: When the record was created in the legacy INSPIRE system, e.g. '2014-11-03'.

legacy_version.description: Version string from that legacy system, e.g. '20181121144046.0'.

license.description: Licence terms, each with the imposing party and a URL, e.g. {'imposing': 'arXiv', ...}. Measured on 4 of 5 records. Whether the text and figures can be reused.

number_of_pages.description: Page count, e.g. 138. A 138-page record is a report or a review, not a letter.

preprint_date.description: When the preprint appeared, e.g. '2014-10-31'. Priority in HEP is usually claimed from this date, not from publication.

primary_arxiv_category.description: The primary arXiv category, e.g. ['hep-ph']. Measured on 3 of 5 records - the one the authors chose as principal, where `categories` is the full list.

public_notes.description: Public notes on the record, each with its source and value, e.g. an arXiv comment. Measured on 3 of 5 records - where 'submitted to', 'proceedings of' and page-count corrections live.

publication_type.description: A finer type, e.g. ['review']. Measured on 1 of 5 records. A review's citation count is not comparable with a research paper's.

refereed.description: True when the work is peer-reviewed. Measured on 4 of 5 records. The difference between a preprint and a published paper, and nothing else in the record states it.

referenced_authors_bais.description: Disambiguated ids of every author cited by this work - 9142 on the measured record. The basis of any co-citation or influence analysis.

references.description: The work's reference list, each with its label, raw reference and a link to the INSPIRE record where resolved - 180 on the measured record. The citation graph, and the schema named none of it.

report_numbers.description: Institutional report numbers, each with its value, e.g. 'EDINBURGH-2014-15' - 5 on the measured record. How the work is referenced inside the issuing laboratories.

texkeys.description: INSPIRE's BibTeX keys for the record, e.g. ['NNPDF:2014otw']. What a LaTeX \cite actually uses, and the first entry is the canonical one.

urls.description: External links for the work, each with a description, e.g. an Interactions.org page. Measured on 2 of 5.

created.description: When the INSPIRE record was created, e.g. '2014-11-03T00:00:00+00:00'.

links.description: Export links for the record or the result set - bibtex, latex-eu, latex-us, json and the rest. How a citation is obtained in the form a journal wants, and 'next' pages the search.

updated.description: When it was last changed, e.g. '2023-03-07T06:50:50.626309+00:00'. Nine years after creation on the measured record - INSPIRE records are curated continuously.

links.description: Export links for the record or the result set - bibtex, latex-eu, latex-us, json and the rest. How a citation is obtained in the form a journal wants, and 'next' pages the search.
